'''Mas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Moorjhoni]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Moorjhone]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. When he tripped while preparing to [[Battle of Moorjhone|attack]] [[Ja'Boag]]'s mine, his brother [[Mootai]] helped him up. [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]] scolded Mootai for doing so, and when Mootai later tripped, Mas left him behind. During the battle, Mas believed Maul when he said [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were there to stop the Moorjhoni.
